name: Amravati
registryBasis: The official Maharashtra Land Records Department lists an Amravati city-survey office; the Amravati district government points residents to Mahabhumi for land records and Mahabhunakasha maps. This confirms a city-local land-record function. The public viewer exposes plot-search and property-card controls, and no safe geometry-only schema was verified.
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.
technicalBlocker: The official BhuNaksha viewer offers plot-number search and a property-card information control. Direct anonymous fetch timed out (HTTP status 000), and no geometry-only layer/schema was verified; no parcel selection or property-card request was made.
scopeLimits: Official district land-record links and state city-survey directory reviewed in English and Marathi. The public viewer was inspected as indexed/static UI metadata only. No plot number, owner, address, property card, tax, or personal data was queried.
remainingUncertainty: A safe geometry-only route could exist within the BhuNaksha viewer, but its service schema and output allowlist could not be verified from the accessible static page.

officialSources.observation: Official Maharashtra Land Records contact directory lists Amravati’s special deputy superintendent for village/city/town survey.
Official Amravati district service page links to Mahabhumi for digitally signed records, property cards and Mahabhunakasha maps with land records.

Official viewer is indexed with “Search Plot No”, “Plot Info” and “Property Card Information”. Direct HTTPS fetch timed out and the web retrieval reported a redirect loop; no plot input or map data was requested.
Municipal corporation map page contains a static image map, not a cadastral parcel service.
